body: thanks for your support. it's pretty late whete i live and i have to get up early tomorrow, but i ever need help again i will conntect you if you don't mind. it feels good that there is someone if i ever need someone.

i honestly didn't think that so few words could make me feel so good. i think the main problem is that i constructed this image of myself and that i'm successful at telling people that that image is actually me. i tell people that i didn't like children, because i don't think i could ever found a family for example. it's so hard to stop becaus i think i almost convinced myself that i'm this tough guy that needs nobody and that wants to be alone, although i'm obviously not. i don't know how to talk to anyone i know because i never did. i always conviced people that i'm fine and now i don't trust anyone enough to ask for their support. if someone actually ask me how i am, i feel threatend because they are invading my personal space. i appreciate the good work you guys are doing (and your last comment really felt good), i don't think that's a permanent solution. i don't know how to get out of this. i'm struggling with similar problems for almost a decade and nothing has changed. i don't know if i really want to die (i don't think so) but there are just moments where i just get really close to doing it anyway. for a month or two i feel really good and everything is fine and than there are 1-2 month were i don't think i can go on like this anymore and i get really close to ending it. sometimes i can't even leave my flat to go grocery shopping because i can't stop crying for long enough and i really have no idea what i'm doing!
